rtxremix.hotkey.header: Hotkeys (click a button, then press a key; Delete clears)
rtxremix.setting.light.fix.tip: Turns all light transform mods on or off. Off = the original rendering. Hotkey: Numpad 1.
rtxremix.setting.light.giReach.tip:
Higher for better Indirect lighting spread.
Off for default behavior.
rtxremix.setting.light.debugMarkers.tip: Marks glass-crossed light: red on shadow rays, green on bounce rays. Needs the diagnostic build.
rtxremix.setting.light.saturation.tip: Strength of stained-glass colour in light passing through. 100 = as shipped.
rtxremix.setting.light.paneDepth.tip: How strongly a glass pane tints what you see through it. 0 = original, 100 = full colour.
rtxremix.setting.light.glassDepth.tip: How deeply a glass block tints. 100 = as shipped. Reload resources (F3+T) or restart to apply.
rtxremix.setting.light.waterBlue.tip: How much blue water lets through. 100 = as shipped. Reload resources (F3+T) or restart to apply.
rtxremix.setting.light.glassGap.tip: Separates touching glass and water faces. Fixes black sky, missing middle glass and flicker.
rtxremix.setting.light.waterUnderside.ti: Test switch: keeps the underside of the water surface.
rtxremix.setting.light.waterNudge.tip: Pulls water faces slightly off touching glass. On by default.
rtxremix.setting.light.sunSize.tip: Sun and moon size in percent. Bigger = softer shadow edges. 100 = as shipped.
rtxremix.setting.light.hotkeys.tip: Enable the hotkeys below. Click a button, press a key; Delete clears.
